cause: ReadAcceptedCorrelationIdAsync invokes ObserveAcceptedCleanup in its finally. CompleteAcceptedCleanupAsync can have no incomplete await when its linked CTS is already canceled: CancelAsync returns a completed task. Disposing that linked CTS can synchronously unregister from a parent cancellation callback that is still executing the provider cancellation callback. The provider waits for the test release, but the test cannot release until its synchronous Advance returns. Real timer/dispatch continuations are also vulnerable to this inline blocking operation.
finalFix: Keep cancellation initiation and bounded cleanup inline; offload only potentially blocking linked source disposal with await Task.Run(cancellation.Dispose).ConfigureAwait(false) in the cleanup finally.
